company.name: Maharah Human Resources Company
company.about: تقدّم مهارة خدمات استقدام العمالة وتوظيفها لقطاع الأفراد وقطاع الأعمال.

careersNote: maharah.com links two careers pages: http://careers.maharah.com/ (did not connect on 20 Nov 2026) and https://apply.workable.com/maharahjobs/ (opened; 9 open roles, all in Riyadh). Recorded the 2 that fit the app's fields. Left out (engineering, outside the app's fields): Architect, Civil Engineer, Electrical Engineer, Mechanical Engineer (22 Oct, Esnad Maharah -Outsource) and their Arabic postings مهندس مدني، مهندس معماري، مهندس ميكانيكي (28 Oct). No data or HR role was open. Evidence lines are copied verbatim from each posting.

jobs.title: Business Development Specialist
jobs.source: Maharah careers (apply.workable.com/maharahjobs, the careers link on maharah.com)
jobs.bandEvidence: 1–3 years of experience in Business Development or B2B Sales.

requirements.evidence: Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Conduct client visits and meetings to present company services.
Generate leads and build a strong sales pipeline.
Monitor market trends and competitor activities.
Negotiate and close deals to achieve sales targets.

jobs.summary: تبحث عن عملاء جدد لخدمات مهارة من قطاع الأعمال، تزورهم وتعرض الخدمات وتفاوض حتى تُغلق الصفقة.
tasks: توليد فرص بيع وبناء قائمة عملاء محتملين
jobs.note: The app has no sales or negotiation skill: marketing-basics (leads) and problem-solving (negotiating and closing) are our reading of the nearest skills. The posting also prefers a valid driving licence.

jobs.title: QA Analyst
jobs.source: Maharah careers (apply.workable.com/maharahjobs, the careers link on maharah.com)

requirements.evidence: Conduct sample testing and validate transactions/processes against approved SOPs, policies and controls.

Provides operational QA execution support through sampling, testing, evidence gathering, documentation and data preparation under the supervision of a QA Specialist, QA Assistant Manager/Officer or QA Manager.
Support data collection and preparation of QA dashboards and reports.
Assist in Root Cause Analysis activities as directed.
Identify and accurately document QA findings and exceptions.

jobs.summary: تراجع عيّنات من المعاملات والإجراءات وتتحقق من مطابقتها للسياسات المعتمدة، وتوثّق الملاحظات وتساعد في تقارير الجودة.
tasks: اختبار عيّنات من المعاملات مقابل الإجراءات المعتمدة
توثيق الملاحظات والأدلة في أنظمة الجودة
jobs.note: Process and operations quality assurance (audit-style), not software testing. Listed under the department «Esnad Maharah -Outsource» (Maharah's outsourcing arm). Bachelor's in Business Administration, Quality Management, Industrial Engineering, Finance or related.
